name: Rizuhble's Drive-By Vindicta
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out in lane. Back off before you use it. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flight T3, Assassinate T1. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Extended Magazine.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Extended Magazine completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Extended Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Long Range
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Extended Magazine completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Extended Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Extended Magazine completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Long Range, High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Extended Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Extended Magazine completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Extended Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Assassinate (2 to 3).

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Counterspell, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Assassinate (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-24,000 (levels 16-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Crow Familiar T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Stake, damage) grows from 66.4 to 142. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Counterspell, spirit 4.8k at Quicksilver Reload.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus. Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Crow Familiar: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Titanic Magazine completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Titanic Magazine completes 6.4k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Crow Familiar: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-46,400 (levels 27-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Assassinate T3.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 62 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Leech? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.
sections.desc: Dying after Leech? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun heroes shoot you out of the sky.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Flight (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and Knockdown keep dropping you out of Flight.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep landing on you.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 25,600 to 30,400 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
